title: PostgreSQL permits whitespace-only versions rejected by bean contract
environment: Independent git-blob-verified snapshot; Java21; real PostgreSQL18.6; loopback ephemeral HTTP
preconditions: Follow qa/independent/PHASE-1-EXECUTION.md; never execute against shared infrastructure.
reproduction_steps: Run the QA-owned IndependentDatabaseAcceptanceTest against isolated real PostgreSQL.
The parameterized method bypasses bean validation using prepared JDBC INSERT.

title: Firewall 400 misses baseline security/cache headers
environment: Independent git-blob-verified snapshot; Java21; real PostgreSQL18.6; loopback ephemeral HTTP
preconditions: Follow qa/independent/PHASE-1-EXECUTION.md; never execute against shared infrastructure.
reproduction_steps: Run the real jar on isolated loopback QA instance.
Send literal double-slash path without redirect following.
Inspect response headers and compare proposed AC4.
actual_result: 400 application/json with correlation ID but missing CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Cache-Control.
expected_result: Proposed AC4 requires baseline headers on every response, including rejected requests; agree scope and cover firewall path.
